speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.

The CT urography confirms the presence of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the renal medulla, which is the hallmark radiographic finding for this condition. This structural anomaly explains your recurrent UTIs, visible hematuria, and right flank pain.
